options.label: Increase the Pro plan price from £49 to £59 per month with the next Pro feature release
Keep the Pro plan at £49 per month when releasing the next Pro feature
Set the list price for new Pro subscribers at £59 per month with the feature release while grandfathering existing Pro subscribers at their current price
Test alternative Pro price-and-feature-release packages before applying a full rollout
Increase perceived Pro value through packaging, positioning, or feature differentiation before or instead of changing price

risks.label: The higher Pro price reduces new-subscriber conversion or upgrades enough to reduce subscriber growth
Existing Pro subscribers perceive insufficient additional value and cancel, causing monthly churn to exceed the constraint
The feature release does not materially increase perceived value or is delayed
Competitor alternatives make the higher price less acceptable
Poorly communicated price changes create dissatisfaction, support burden, or reputational harm
Grandfathering existing subscribers may limit near-term MRR uplift despite reducing retention risk
Aggregate monthly churn may obscure materially different churn responses among Pro customer segments

outcomes.label: Reach at least £20k in monthly recurring revenue within 12 months
Higher revenue per retained Pro subscriber
Higher or lower Pro subscriber growth depending on conversion, upgrades, and churn response
Improved price-to-value alignment for customers who value the new Pro features
Potentially lower revenue growth if reduced acquisition or increased churn outweighs the price increase
